changes.reason: The bounded complete experiment set holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0->0.05 while leaving terminal_tip_speed_weight at 0.0. It reduced the sampled holding-window maximum world-tip speed by 0.4060100069642385 m/s (F1563), a real change in the predicted direction, so an unpenalized hold tip-speed term is a genuine contributor. But the candidate still records holding_max_speed_m_s=1.1750052670100422 (F1185), about 59x the 0.02 m/s limit (F1069), with holding_speed_passed=false (F1605). The missing penalty is therefore a minor contributor and does not account for the observed blow-up; the hypothesis is weakened as an explanation for the failure.

Budget saturation persisted: deadline_misses stayed at 35 in both runs (F996, F1033; delta 0, F1007) and the added cost term raised mean complete-update time by 0.5154540428891785 s (F1139). At the same time the changed applied outcomes show the solver did respond to the altered cost rather than returning an unchanged seed. Budget-driven plan selection remains a plausible contributor; this paired weight change does not certify it as a cause.
The experiment changed only a weight, not the horizon. Per-update effective_horizon was not newly observed in this phase, so this hypothesis is unaffected by the new evidence and stays unresolved.

Both runs record force_bound_violation_n=0.0 (F1230 baseline, F1681 candidate) and no new per-tendon saturation evidence was produced. The hypothesis remains untested rather than supported or refuted.

Terminal reach still passes in both runs: candidate terminal_error_m=0.00869890424761182 m (F1197) inside the 0.01 m tolerance (candidate terminal_reach_passed=true, F1065), as before (F1649). The failure is not terminal reach, so this cause stays rejected.

One paired weight change yields comparison classification physical_tradeoff (F1522) with mixed physical effects and no counterfactual replay; no dominant cause is established from a single execution and one model comparison.

The deferral was premised solely on the diagnostic phase having no authorized saved-state check or complete experiment. That premise no longer holds: the improvement phase granted and executed one bounded complete experiment, producing exactly the holding-speed comparison this recommendation deferred, so the deferral no longer governs.

Causality remains uncertified. A single paired weight change with mixed physical effects (holding improved, reach and computation worsened) cannot attribute the reach/holding outcomes to any weight or mechanism, so the deferral of closed-loop counterfactual replay and causal attribution still applies.

new_facts.statement: Candidate-minus-baseline terminal reach worsened but both runs still passed: candidate terminal_error_m = 0.00869890424761182 m (F1197) versus baseline 0.007642608585867386 m (F1649), a delta of +0.001056295661744434 m (F1310); candidate terminal_reach_passed = true (F1065) and candidate official_reach_task_success = true (F1149).

Candidate-minus-baseline sampled holding speed improved but still failed: candidate holding_max_speed_m_s = 1.1750052670100422 (F1185) versus baseline 1.5810152739742807 (F815), delta -0.4060100069642385 m/s (F1563); both remain far above speed_limit_m_s = 0.02 (F1069) and candidate holding_speed_passed = false (F1605).

Candidate-minus-baseline sampled holding position improved but still failed: candidate holding_max_error_m = 0.05650455971948983 (F1588) versus baseline 0.05813810428573256 (F1596), delta -0.001633544566242727 m (F799); both exceed position_limit_m = 0.01 (F1519) and candidate holding_position_passed = false (F1212).

Candidate-minus-baseline complete-update computation worsened: candidate mean_complete_update_s = 17.77877309145406 (F1157) versus baseline 17.26331904856488 (F1136), delta +0.5154540428891785 s (F1139), with deadline_misses unchanged at 35 in both runs (F996, F1033; delta 0, F1007).

Joint acceptance is unchanged by the change: candidate joint_reach_holding_passed = false (F1104) and baseline joint_reach_holding_passed = false (F1683); the comparison classification is physical_tradeoff (F1522) and force_bound_violation_n = 0.0 in both runs (F1230 baseline, F1681 candidate).

new_limitations: A single paired complete experiment changing one weight does not establish causality: the candidate-versus-baseline differences conflate the controller change with run-to-run variation, and no closed-loop counterfactual replay is available (F776; F1522).
Sampled holding windows cover only the final 0.05 s (6 rows) and give no continuous-time guarantee (F1392, F1619, F847); cited arithmetic does not certify scientific prose or a dominant cause.
arguments.rationale: Recommendation acceptance is kept separate from controller-candidate selection: the diagnostic deferrals were premised only on absent authorization, and the improvement phase superseded that premise by granting and executing one bounded complete experiment, whose independent sealed comparison is now in hand. Reading that comparison by dimension: reach — terminal error rose by 0.001056295661744434 m (F1310) but both runs stay inside the 0.01 m tolerance (F1065); holding position — sampled max error fell by 0.001633544566242727 m (F799) yet remains above 0.01 m (F1212); holding speed — sampled max speed fell by 0.4060100069642385 m/s (F1563) yet remains ~59x the 0.02 m/s limit (F1605, F1185); computation — mean complete-update time rose by 0.5154540428891785 s (F1139) with deadline_misses unchanged at 35 (F1007). Since each run shows a physical improvement alongside a physical worsening and joint acceptance is unchanged, the objective outcome is a trade-off, not an overall improvement. This weakens 'hold.tip_speed_unpenalized' as an adequate explanation (the penalty moves the sampled hold speed in the right direction but by a negligible fraction of the gap) while leaving the budget-truncation and horizon-truncation hypotheses untested and hence unresolved, and it keeps 'reach_tolerance_exceeded' rejected and 'dominant_cause.single_execution' retained. No causal attribution is drawn from cited arithmetic; only the named 'controller.budget_truncated_plan_selection' and 'rec-defer-causal-replay' items are retained, and the comparison-derived statements are limited to the four required candidate-profile fields (F1157, F1185, F1197, F1588) plus their baseline and delta counterparts.
arguments.recommendation: Do not select improvement-96f0ade35119 (holding_tip_speed_weight 0.0->0.05) as an overall improvement: the sealed comparison classifies it as a physical_tradeoff (F1522) and joint_reach_holding_passed stays false (F1104). Keep this separate from accepting/rejecting the diagnostic deferrals. Record the separate outcomes: reach worsened but still passes (terminal error 0.007642608585867386 -> 0.00869890424761182 m); holding position improved but still fails (0.05813810428573256 -> 0.05650455971948983 m vs 0.01 m limit); holding speed improved but still fails (1.5810152739742807 -> 1.1750052670100422 m/s vs 0.02 m/s limit, ~59x); computation worsened (mean complete-update 17.26331904856488 -> 17.77877309145406 s, deadline_misses unchanged at 35). Because the holding tip-speed penalty did not bring the sampled hold speed anywhere near the limit, treat additional weight-only tuning of that term as a low-yield lever on this baseline. If a further bounded experiment is authorized, prioritize the persistent computation/solve-budget and horizon-truncation observations (both untested here) over more weight-only changes, without asserting causal attribution.
